original_record.title: Charge expiry omits the reached end-of-action clear for remaining count 1
original_record.behavioral_fact: Charge starts at 2. Normal round-tail processing can reduce it to 1. Reaching the end-of-action cleanup clears exactly count 1 before later Instruct/Dancer processing; count 2 is not cleared by that action cleanup. The clear is not conditional on having used an Electric move or on successfully dealing damage.
prerequisites: Default Charge was successfully used; no special ability/item/state callbacks alter the counter.
Both sides remain able to battle; a later ordinary move attempt reaches its normal end-of-action cleanup.

For the repeat example: a legal positive-PP ordinary Electric move is in the user’s current slots, normal gates pass, and a later ally uses legal Instruct after the user’s ordinary action; no special blacklist, locks, switching, fainting or host fault applies.
original_record.minimal_counterexample: Charge succeeds in round n: counter 2, then full round-tail 1. In round n+1 the user performs its normal Electric move: its initial damage reads positive Charge and receives the Charge power multiplier. The normal action end clears counter 1 to 0. A later ally’s Instruct repeats that Electric move in the same round, so the repeat reads 0 and receives no Charge multiplier. A timer-only implementation inferred from WP44 keeps 1 through both actions until the round tail and boosts the repeat incorrectly.
original_record.ordinary_control: Immediately after newly setting Charge to 2, reaching that same action’s end leaves it 2; this is distinct from the count-1 clear. Another independent control removes Instruct and still observes the counter clear after the ordinary action.
original_record.cancellation_or_partial_commitment: Successful first damage, PP and history stay committed; a later repeat does not undo them.
